Admin routes of the gift cards module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/gift-cards

List gift cards

Parameters:

- `isActive` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `purchasedBy` in query (string, optional).
- `recipientEmail` in query (string, optional).
- `sortBy` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Gift cards retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/gift-cards

Issue gift card

Request body: [CreateGiftCardAdminDto](#creategiftcardadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Gift card issued.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## GET /v1/admin/gift-cards/{id}

Get gift card by ID

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Gift card retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Gift card not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/gift-cards/{id}

Update gift card

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateGiftCardAdminDto](#updategiftcardadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Gift card updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Gift card not found.

## POST /v1/admin/gift-cards/{id}/adjust

Adjust gift card balance

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [AdjustGiftCardBalanceDto](#adjustgiftcardbalancedto).

Responses:

- `200`: Balance adjusted.
- `201`: no description. Body: object.
- `400`: Invalid input (zero delta, overdraw, inactive).
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Gift card not found.

## POST /v1/admin/gift-cards/{id}/resend

Resend gift card email

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Email queued.
- `400`: No recipient on file / card inactive.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Gift card not found.

## Schemas

### AdjustGiftCardBalanceDto

- `amount` (number, required).
- `reason` (string, min length 3, max length 500, required).
- `referenceId` (string, max length 128, optional).

### CreateGiftCardAdminDto

- `initialBalance` (number, min 1, required).
- `currency` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{3}$/`, required).
- `code` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z0-9]{8,20}$/`, optional).
- `recipientEmail` (string, optional).
- `recipientName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `personalMessage` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), optional).
- `purchasedBy` (string, optional).
- `expiresAt` (string, optional).
- `isActive` (boolean, optional).

### TranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).

### UpdateGiftCardAdminDto

- `isActive` (boolean, optional).
